t2.thesis: ALAB enters earnings after a sharp ~33% one-month drawdown and an AI selloff, with a high bar already priced in (14.7% implied move), so the setup is roughly balanced with a slight lean up from washed-out positioning and strong fundamentals.
reasons: Semis cluster base rate is weak (0.479), but ai_infra and AMC rates are higher, so the prior sits near 0.51
Stock down ~33% in 1m and ~52% from the 52w high, with 5d return -10%: positioning is washed out, which favors a relief bounce on a beat
Fundamentals strong: revenue +104% YoY, Q3 guide of $540-560M, EPS estimates revised up 48% over 90d, a Scorpio ramp one quarter early
Headline I6 notes the stock fell after its last 3 revenue beats; the last-4 reaction record is mixed (-16% in Feb, +0.7% in Aug), so beats do not guarantee a rise
Macro risk: Nasdaq 100 near correction and AI capex worries could cap any rally; implied move of 14.7% is large and symmetric
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 revenue guide versus elevated whisper numbers (likely well above $540-560M run-rate extrapolation) and gross margin trajectory, in the context of AI capex sentiment.

prior.from: I3: semis cluster t0_hit 0.479 (n=434), AMC overall 0.538, overall ~0.54; blended to about 0.51 for a semis AMC name

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. Today is 2026-11-02, so that earnings report on 2026-11-03 hasn't happened yet, and I have no information on how Astera Labs (ALAB) stock will react.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved up about +0.02 from 0.51 to 0.53 for the depressed pre-earnings positioning and strong estimate revisions, partly offset by the weak semis base rate and the pattern of selling off after beats.

theses.expected: Rise: beat and a guide well above consensus with Scorpio ramp commentary, short covering after the selloff
theses.mechanism: Depressed price and strong estimate revisions make the bar beatable; a large guide lifts the stock at the next open
theses.wrong_if: Guide only in line with the buy-side whisper or gross margin guides below 72%

theses.expected: Fall: sell the news despite a beat, as in the past three prints
theses.mechanism: Elevated expectations at 35x forward P/E and margin dilution from hardware modules and warrants cause de-rating
theses.wrong_if: The stock opens higher on a beat with raised guidance despite the AI selloff

theses.expected: Flat to modest move: the market shrugs and the macro AI trade dominates
theses.mechanism: Sector-wide AI capex fears drive the open, overwhelming company-specific results
theses.wrong_if: Company-specific surprise produces a move beyond the 14.7% implied range

key_observations: Q4 revenue guide versus consensus and the buy-side whisper
Non-GAAP gross margin guide (about 72% last quarter)
Scorpio X-Series ramp timing and customer diversification
Commentary on hyperscaler capex and 2027 growth
Opex growth and the effect of the Amazon warrant on margins
